english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for foolish or silly acts and behavior.
Use this when “madness” means a foolish or rash thing someone does, rather than a mental illness.

examples.english: Your constant buffoonery is really giving me a headache.
examples.traditional: 你成日做埋啲傻事，真係令人頭痛。

examples.english: Quitting your job on a whim is madness.
examples.traditional: 你一時衝動就辭職，真係傻事嚟㗎。
